text: Figure 9.69: Interfaces for recovery Name: RecoveryAction Technology: Port interface Generated: No Meta-model interface type: PhmRecoveryActionInterface Usage: Public API Description: This interface provides functions to control triggering of recovery actions, to determine the status of the supervision and a callback to perform recovery . GetGlobalSupervisionStatus Returns the status of global supervision that the supervised entity belongs to. Offer Enables potential invocations of the callback RecoveryHandler(). RecoveryHandler Callback to be invoked by Platform Health Management upon a supervision failure. The handler invocation needs to be enabled before using Offer(). Operations: StopOffer Disables potential invocations of the callback RecoveryHandler().
